description: Follow-up to .14.2.2 for hidden Bcc on inbound email. Current IMAP settings expose username and selected folder names, neither independently attests the address that received a message. Determine authoritative account-address evidence available from adapter/server and persist/validate a connector-scoped account identity only when independently established; if unavailable, leave Bcc unassociated and document limitation rather than infer from Delivered-To, folder or header. Any BO UI change must stay under communication-channel settings and read DESIGN.md/docs/bo-components.md first; new-feature E2E authoring waits for human UX approval. Tests first for alias, multi-account ambiguity, mismatched connector and denial of unsupported Bcc. Reuse existing IMAP configuration and IdentityResolver, no new agent Action/tool.
title: [zaq-emb.14.2.5] Establish receiving-account identity evidence
